name: hound-jump-surge
description: hound-jump.json replayed at the SURGE pace (?pace=surge&hound=1): identical to hound-grounded-surge.json plus one jump inside the first houndframe's telegraph. Surge is the pace that changes launch behavior (auto-launch on dwell expiry, chained launches, refunded air jump), so this is the run that shows the tell still buys the player a movement answer when the verbs are at their crispest.
